detail: manifests/firewall_addon_xrdp.pp: ### Purpose ########
manifests/firewall_addon_xrdp.pp: # This class opens firewall ports so sysadmins
manifests/firewall_addon_xrdp.pp: # are able to access machines with the helpdesk feature
manifests/firewall_addon_xrdp.pp: # Ref: https://bitbucket.org/asolidodev/is-desktop8/wiki/Helpdesk%20connection
manifests/firewall_addon_xrdp.pp: # The behind this rule is the following:
manifests/firewall_addon_xrdp.pp: #
manifests/firewall_addon_xrdp.pp: # xrdp communicates with VNC initially using IPv6 and only if that fails IPv4 is used
manifests/firewall_addon_xrdp.pp: #
manifests/firewall_addon_xrdp.pp: # However DROPpping IPv6 traffic with iptables like we usually do, is not seen as a failure
manifests/firewall_addon_xrdp.pp: # from the XRDP standpoint. When IPv6 traffic is DROPped the connection to VNC does not work
manifests/firewall_addon_xrdp.pp: #
manifests/firewall_addon_xrdp.pp: # https://github.com/neutrinolabs/xrdp/issues/1596
manifests/firewall_addon_xrdp.pp: #
manifests/firewall_addon_xrdp.pp: # To fix that we open INPUT with dport 5900 in lo so xrdp can communicate with vnc.
manifests/firewall_addon_xrdp.pp: # xrdp will initiate a connection from lo:XXXX with destionation lo:5900
manifests/firewall_addon_xrdp.pp: # which will be accepted by the INPUT rule. Although vnc will respond from
manifests/firewall_addon_xrdp.pp: # lo:5900 to lo:XXXX and this comunication will not be accepted if the ESTABLISHED
manifests/firewall_addon_xrdp.pp: # rule does not exist

header: # @summary Adds firewall rules required for XRDP helpdesk access.
# @note XRDP attempts the local VNC connection over IPv6 before falling back to
#   IPv4. Allowing local IPv6 VNC traffic avoids hangs when the default IPv6
#   policy drops packets without causing an XRDP-visible connection failure.
